documents.title: Constitution of the Independent State of Papua New Guinea
documents.issuing_authority: National Parliament of Papua New Guinea
documents.reviewer_notes: Verification in progress. The recorded Parliament-hosted PDF returned a 404 error during an attempted access; retry and locate an alternative official copy. PacLII provides a consolidated Constitution marked as at 16 May 2025, but this date does not establish currency as at October 2026. The Department of Prime Minister and NEC reported passage of a constitutional amendment concerning PNG's Christian identity in March 2025. A July 2026 news report states that the Supreme Court upheld constitutional changes concerning Section 145. Obtain authoritative records of the relevant amendments and court decision, establish their legal effect and commencement, compare the applicable text, and confirm redistribution permissions before approval.
